title: Rory and the Moonlit Hollow
verses:
The moon started rising above the dark trees,
And Psittaco chirped from a nest in the height.
A cozy soft pathway was brushed by the breeze,
To guide all the friends through the peaceful blue night.

Big Benny walked slow with a heavy soft tread,
While Tilly picked moss that was fluffy and deep.
They cleared a wide space for a comfortable bed,
Where everyone soon would be falling asleep.

Brave Ricky curled down with his chin on his paw,
As Nia swooped in with a flutter of grace.
The prettiest valley they ever yet saw,
Was wrapped in cool shade in this slumbering place.

Green Rory let out a great yawn that was slow,
Then settled right next to his gentle best friend.
The small little guide nestled down in the glow,
Beneath a soft wing as the day reached its end.

The fireflies danced as they shimmered and gleamed,
Above the cool grass where the dinos lay tight.
The silver stars twinkled and quietly beamed,
To cover the world in a blanket of light.

Each eye closed so gently, each heart was at rest,
The forest grew silent, so cozy and still.
Tucked into the valley they loved all the best,
As dreamland crept over the moon-dusted hill.
